convert_pvt_checkpoint: convert a PVT pretrained checkpoint from the original library to HuggingFace PyTorch format
create_rename_keys: create a list of weight key renaming mappings from original PVT to HuggingFace PVT config
read_in_k_v: split the combined key-value weight matrix into separate key and value weight tensors
prepare_img: prepare a test image from the COCO dataset for verifying converted model outputs
run_pvt_conversion_cli: run the PVT checkpoint conversion CLI with size, checkpoint path, and output directory arguments
